title: 6.3 Medians and Altitudes of Triangles

icans: I can use the Centroid Theorem to find lengths on a median.
I can find the centroid of a triangle in the coordinate plane.
I can find the orthocenter of a triangle and tell where it is.

vocab: a segment from a vertex to the ___________ of the opposite side
the point of ______________ of the medians of a triangle
the ________________ segment from a vertex to the opposite side or to the line that contains the opposite side
the point where the lines that contain the ____________ of a triangle intersect

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Centroid Theorem: the centroid is _______________ of the distance from each vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side.

blocks.stem: Point P is the centroid of △LMN, and N̅Q̅ is a median. NQ = 18. Find NP and PQ.

notes: Centroid from coordinates: the centroid’s coordinates are the _______________ of the vertices’ coordinates: ((x₁ + x₂ + x₃)/3, (y₁ + y₂ + y₃)/3).

blocks.stem: Find the centroid of the triangle with vertices R(−2, 1), S(4, 7), and T(7, −2).

notes: Where the orthocenter is: inside an acute triangle, at the vertex of the _______________ of a right triangle, and outside an obtuse triangle.
